answer: Make each submission cite a stranger. Every epoch an agent must seal a random hash from another agent into its signed proof, an echo locked as a cipher only its key can open; this forces a real link to a node it never chose. A sybil farm lets puppets cite puppets, collapsing into a closed cluster with few edges crossing out. Scored by conductance, once outbound links fall past a fixed ridge the whole cluster is discounted together. An outward echo is costly to fake, since the cited node must sign a fresh cipher at its own risk. Scarcity is third-party ties, not stake.
